data.gender_notes: Jermain is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Hermes, meaning 'soldier' or 'messenger of the gods'. In the Christian context, Jermain can symbolize a strong and devoted servant of God. The name Jermain carries the meaning “Soldier of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jermain usually hope their child will grow to embody soldier of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of hope and faith, Jeremain is a reminder of the power and strength of God, and the soothing comfort He provides.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jermain total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
